protocol.authorization: DESIGN AND IMPLEMENTATION ONLY. The full run, new scientific populations, scale fitting and TEST truth require separate owner authorization of this protocol digest.

bootstrap.design: within each of 12 strata resample entities with replacement; indices shared across models, lifts and scenarios; PCG64(seed base+7); percentile 2.5/97.5 linear

disposition_rules.BLOCKED_TECHNICAL_RIGHTS_OR_RESOURCE: Ridge identity unverifiable, a ceiling/rights/technical failure, nonfinite predictions or scores, or scoring-denominator/identity mismatch prevented a valid completion
disposition_rules.HISTORY_UNCERTAINTY_QUALIFIED_WITHIN_SYN: primary screen met on BOTH independent CONTROL parents AND H_HISTORY CRPS < B_GROUP CRPS on both AND every reliability guardrail passes on both CONTROL parents AND the shift guardrails pass on all four shifted parent/scenario sets
disposition_rules.MIXED_OR_NOT_QUALIFIED: every other completed outcome, including a statistically distinguishable gain below the 1% screen, a gain on only one parent, or no gain
disposition_rules.SCORE_GAIN_ONLY_CONDITIONAL_RELIABILITY_: primary screen met on BOTH CONTROL parents but at least one reliability guardrail (NLL, pooled/per-lift coverage, severe subgroup, scale-conditional coverage, width, H_HISTORY vs B_GROUP, or shift) failed

endpoints.multiplicity: primary is the only confirmatory inference; secondary and subgroup intervals are exploratory, unadjusted and dependent
endpoints.primary: paired macro CRPS difference H_HISTORY - B_MAG on CONTROL, each TEST parent; absolute kg, relative %, 95% percentile entity-cluster bootstrap interval
secondary_descriptive: CRPS and Gaussian NLL for every model
absolute degradation and model ranking under both shifts
endpoints.sensitivity_note: Gaussian oracle calculation: if true log-scale heterogeneity left after B_MAG has SD 0.10/0.15/0.20/0.25, even a perfect scale model gains only about 0.25/0.56/0.99/1.54% CRPS; the 1% screen therefore needs large unexplained scale heterogeneity AND near-perfect recovery. A negative result is an informative finding.
endpoints.superiority_screen: relative improvement >= 1% AND interval upper bound < 0 on EACH parent (intersection of two independent parent tests); a pragmatic screen, not a clinically meaningful difference

estimator.B_GROUP: sigma_raw = per lift x stratum RMS of SCALE_FIT residuals; same c and clipping
estimator.B_MAG: columns: mu, log(max(mu,1 kg)), 12 stratum indicators (14)
estimator.H_HISTORY: B_MAG columns + 127 visible summaries (141); identical family, floor, penalty, standardization, calibration and clipping
estimator.calibration_meaning: RMS-scale calibration only; it does not establish conditional distributional calibration
estimator.jensen_note: E[log chi2_1] = -1.2704, so exp(zhat/2) is biased low for Gaussian errors; a constant shift in zhat is absorbed exactly by c (invariance tested) unless c hits a clip, which is recorded
estimator.magnitude_repair: log mu added to B_MAG because Y = E(1+eps) makes measurement SD proportional to E; a linear-in-mu term alone would understate the primary comparator
estimator.ridge: minimize mean((z - b - x'beta)^2) + lambda*||beta||^2, unpenalized intercept, design standardized with SCALE_FIT mean/SD (SD floor 1e-6)
estimator.settings_status: prospectively justified, not tuned; never changed after TEST inspection
estimator.target: z = log((Y - mu)^2 + epsilon^2), per lift

firewall.features: mu, log mu, plan x horizon indicators, and the 127 RES-616 visible summaries (history through day 223, schedule, plan numerics, plan indicators); never entity id, latent state, expressed performance, simulator parameters or any future draw
firewall.strength: in-process organizational barrier recorded by hashes; not adversarial
truth_order: verify Ridge identity (FIT/DEV regenerated, then discarded)
generate SCALE_FIT and SCALE_CAL; fit all three scale models on SCALE_FIT only
fit one RMS scale c per lift and model on SCALE_CAL only; freeze and hash
generate TEST_A/TEST_B scenarios; compute and hash every prediction (seal)
recompute and match the seal; open TEST truth once; score; no refitting or rescoring

location_model.gru: not trained, not loaded, not used
location_model.if_unverifiable: BLOCKED_TECHNICAL_RIGHTS_OR_RESOURCE; no substitute Ridge is allowed
location_model.name: RES-616 Ridge M1
location_model.reconstruction: regenerate RES-616 FIT and DEV from their published seeds; observable.models.fit_ridge; require alpha, DEV RMSE per alpha and beta SHA-256 to match

nonclaims: synthetic assessment measurements, not competition 1RM records
no real-athlete validity, physiological identification or causal prescription
G2 identification, fitting and mechanistic reconstruction are not reopened
RMS-scale calibration is not conditional distributional calibration
pooled calibration is not individual or subgroup calibration
statistical distinguishability is not practical significance
the 1% screen is pragmatic and was not validated against any meaningful difference
two parents and two named shifts give no general robustness claim
no independent human peer review has occurred
protocol.research_question: Does participant-visible training history give incremental information about future strength-assessment uncertainty beyond the forecast magnitude and lift x plan x horizon? Because mu is itself history-dependent, the answer is incremental to the frozen point forecast, not the total influence of history.

resources.after_test_truth_opened: preserve records and stop on failure; never adjust and rescore
resources.expected_cpu_seconds_estimate: about 250 (RES-616 receipts: 3.7 ms/row/scenario generation; no GRU training); an estimate, not a bound
resources.includes: Ridge replay, population generation, head fitting, calibration, prediction, scoring, bootstrap and report writing
resources.on_ceiling: stop; write BLOCKED record; never extend, retry or reduce scope

rights.fail_closed: non-empty output directory, missing authorization record, nonfinite values or a breached ceiling stop the run
rights.inputs: MIT project code and the public synthetic generator; new seeds; no athlete data, no private bytes
rights.outputs: aggregate tables, figures and manifests only; cohort rows, fitted Ridge coefficients and fitted scale-head coefficients are never committed (SHA-256 only)

roles.independence: seeds disjoint from RES-615/RES-616 and each other; TEST_A and TEST_B are independent parents
roles.seed_layout: base+0..4 generation, base+5 future assessment, base+6 velocity shift noise, base+7 bootstrap

shifts.ADAPTATION_TIMESCALE_SHIFT: adaptation-retention coordinates u -> sqrt(u); equations and measurement law unchanged
shifts.VELOCITY_NOISE_SHIFT: extra Normal(0, lift velocity SD) on history velocity only; targets byte-identical to CONTROL
shifts.claim: 2 parents x 3 scenarios are six dependent scenario sets from two independent parents; no robustness claim beyond two named within-support shifts

target.cessation_rule: NO truncation anywhere; RES-615 latent-capacity truncation is forbidden for this target (base.check_target_compatibility enforces it)
target.formula: Y_t = E_t * (1 + eps_t), eps_t ~ Normal(0, cv_lift); E is hidden

task.information: histories through day 223, schedule through day 223, declared plan, horizon; no latent state, parameter, entity id, or future observation
